title: Automation records: triggers (monitor, schedule, event, manual) bound to procedures (M)
description:
Add automation records to each site's backend: a trigger bound to a procedure key plus an input template, run through the one run contract (PPY-433383).

Scope:
- Backend model: an Automation record with trigger, procedure key, input template, enabled flag, budget/timeout, concurrency limit, idempotency key and alarm settings.
- Trigger kinds: monitor, schedule, event, manual.
- Schedule triggers use EventBridge Scheduler, created from the record by IaC; nothing manual.
- Event triggers come from existing domain events: reference ingested, story approved, proposal enters review.
- Migrate the existing monitor trigger (as used by Distinctive's TTAB monitor) onto an Automation record without changing its behaviour.
- Enable/disable per automation. Budget, concurrency limit and idempotency key are enforced at run start; a duplicate or over-limit start is recorded and refused.
- Alarms on failure and on a missed schedule.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each of the four trigger kinds starts a run of a registered procedure with its input template.
- A disabled automation never starts; a duplicate idempotency key does not start a second run; the concurrency limit is honoured.
- The migrated monitor starts the same run as before.
- A failure and a missed schedule raise an alarm.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required, plus CDK assertions for the scheduler and alarms.

Depends on PPY-433383.
